verdict.rationale: Bulk search is well supported: there is a Bulk Search option on the site, and the API checks availability for up to 50 domains per call. A community user reports that the UI lets you select 50 domains at once and change all their nameservers in one step. Registration, transfer and renewal, however, are documented only as per-domain API endpoints, which could be scripted but are not shown as true bulk operations. Missing for 10: native bulk registration, bulk renewal and bulk transfer-in operations; first-party documentation of bulk nameserver changes; independent corroboration beyond one community anecdote.
